name: XREADGROUP
description: 消费者组模式读取 Stream 消息——支持消息确认、未确认消息重投、新消息分发，是实现可靠消息队列的核心命令
synopsis: XREADGROUP GROUP group consumer [COUNT count] [BLOCK ms] [NOACK] STREAMS key [key ...] id [id ...]

common_options.name: COUNT count
common_options.description: 最多返回 count 条消息

common_options.name: BLOCK ms
common_options.description: 阻塞等待 ms 毫秒

common_options.name: NOACK
common_options.description: 不等待确认，读取后即标记已处理

examples.code: XREADGROUP GROUP mygroup consumer1 COUNT 5 STREAMS mystream >
XREADGROUP GROUP mygroup consumer1 STREAMS mystream 0
